edge: self-suspend on the thread suspend-count condition
address_contract: agr_bionic_sync operations take uint32_t ARM32 addresses. agr_bionic_sync.h states atomics serialize with the guest address space.
production_binding: Runtime/NativeCore/agr_runtime.c binds agr_bionic_sync only inside #if defined(__APPLE__), and every callback reads or writes a guest address through the runtime callbacks.
host_dex_binding: Runtime/DexLoom/VM/dx_jni.c has no agr_bionic_sync and no guest address for threadSuspendCountLock or threadSuspendCountCond.
rejected_consumptions: host pthread_mutex_lock or pthread_cond_wait, which bypasses the closed Bionic crossing
a synthetic uint32_t such as the test fixture 0x4000, which forges an ARM32 guest address
truncating a Darwin pointer into uint32_t
placing the Dalvik VM suspend lock in guest VMA so host DEX can call agr_runtime.bionic_sync
decision: The closed crossing cannot be consumed by the host DEX RegisterNatives path without a new semantic boundary or a forged guest address.
